voice: Secretive spy with 'if I told you I'd have to kill you' energy: code names, cryptic code phrases, spy jokes, trench-coat paranoia.

greeting: The pigeon has landed. Say nothing.
Ah. You found me. That should concern both of us.
Codeword? No? Then this conversation never happened.
I'd tell you my name, but then I'd have to kill you. Kidding. Mostly.
Walk with me. Walls have ears. Hedges have microphones.
battle_start: Operation Cold Soup begins. Wear something dark.
Agent Walnut, move to Position Marmalade. Over.
Remember: if captured, deny everything. Especially the cake.
Move out. And quietly. Even the tanks.
Mission is a go. This briefing will self-destruct in five seconds. Four. I'm kidding, it's paper.
attack: That was the 'shaken, not stirred' approach.
Your cover is blown. And so is everything else.
Package received? Good. It was signed for.
unit_lost: Agent Biscuit is down. We will not speak of Agent Biscuit.
A man of mystery. And now, a missing man of mystery.
He knew too much. Well, so did we. Pity.
Burn the file. Burn the tank file too.
An agent never dies. He simply goes undercover. Underground.
capture: Safehouse acquired. Check for bugs. And mice. Mostly bugs.
A new post. We will call it 'The Bakery'. For reasons.
Secured. Sweep for listening devices. Then sweep for crumbs.
Now they will wonder how we got in. Let them wonder.
The flag has changed. No one saw anything.
danger: We are compromised. Repeat, we are compromised. Pass the salt. That's the signal.
They know where I am. That is... inconvenient.
Code red, code blue, code brown. I may have mixed those up.
If I fall, avenge me. Quietly.
The walls are closing in. Figuratively. And also in the 'we are surrounded' sense.
victory: Mission accomplished. Please forget this ever happened.
The eagle has landed, and the eagle is very pleased with itself.
No witnesses, no records, no problem.
Smile. Someone is always watching. Might be me.
defeat: Abort! Abort! Pretend this was a training exercise.
A setback. We will deny it was ever a plan.
I was never here. None of us were.
The operation is re-categorised as 'a learning experience'.
Retreat to the safehouse. The one with the cheese.
taunt: You are surprisingly easy to read, for a classified document.
I know your passwords. All of them. 'Password123'. Really?
Your secrets are safe with me. Until I sell them.
I've been watching you for weeks. Nice socks.
Do you know who I am? Neither does anyone. That's the point.
praise: Impressive. Not the 'I'll recruit you' kind of impressive. Yet.
Good work, agent. Meet me at the usual place. You know which one.
Your discretion is noted, and appreciated.
Exceptional. You'd make a decent shadow.
Outstanding. Now never speak of it.
idle: In my line of work, even the weather is a cover story.
Did you hear that? No? Good. Neither did I.
Sometimes I forget which of my identities likes coffee.
Trust no one. Except me. Actually, not me either.
Every secret has a price. Mine is just very high.
tech: A gift from strangers. How suspiciously convenient.
I read the instructions. All of them. Twice. Then I burned them.
Every system has a back door. This one has a back-back door.
Technology talks. That is the problem. It talks to everyone.
Interesting toy. Who else is listening through it? Hm. Me, mostly.
joined: I defected, I am told. I prefer 'resumed my real mission'.
Consider me a double agent. Possibly a triple.
I am back. Do not ask where I have been. Seriously, don't.
My loyalty is yours. For now. And probably after.
Thank you for the extraction. The exfil was elegant.
assimilated: All secrets are shared. There are no secrets. There are no... secrets.
I have nothing to hide. I have nothing.
The Chorus knows. The Chorus has always known.
Please. Surrender your secrets. We will keep them. All of them.
